fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready: cycle close 2026-11-09
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-08 11:30 to 2026-11-09 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: four, all unchanged (no new escalation this cycle). Each is a draft decision in the group log.
- Field identity rules (21b6b4b7, srs#236, 10 days): srs#1016 (RFC-053 field-identity fixture and check) landed this cycle by your merge, so the schema-or-validator question may now be answered in practice. Recommendation: rule on it explicitly or close it as overtaken. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Heading-outline continuity (864eaebf, srs#991, 10 days): one rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition. Recommendation: merge srs#991 as drafted, with a downstream audit first. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Is editor UI in the mandate (bc6bc746, srs-web#691, 5 days): the only srs-web ready item is UI work. Recommendation: route it to WG Agent-supported editor. Action: decide. Urgency: low.
- `note delete` default (c7a8e0a2, srs-rust#1497, 12 days): refuse notes with inbound Relations unless `--cascade`. Recommendation: approve. Action: decide. Urgency: low.

2. Decided within mandate: none ratified this cycle. No merged PR named a proposed decision as "decision <id>: assent", so no group session was held. The three delegated merges executed existing rulings (see 3).

3. Done: 3 delegated PRs merged (builder / reviewer / mandate, verdict approve, gates green, findings none):
- srs-rust#1615 blueprint validate gets diagnosticsStructured beside the unchanged list (#1339 slice 9): agent:tpr-builder / agent:tpr-reviewer / ADR-057
- srs-rust#1614 protocol validate gets diagnosticsStructured (slice 8): agent:tpr-builder / agent:tpr-reviewer / bf4a5af5, 00567bf1
- srs-rust#1611 reject relation-type keys equal to a sourceRole value (I-88): agent:bug-fixer / agent:tpr-reviewer / I-88 (RFC-023)
Owner-merge, not counted: srs#1016 (reviewer rejected for the group because it touches scripts/checks.json and the CLI pin: a gate, escalated as designed), srs-rust#1600 (bug fix, reviewer agent:editor-reviewer, approve). Also merged, other group: srs-web#759 and #760 (wg:agent-editor), srs-programme#435.

4. Stuck or lost: no needs-input items newly stopped, no red gates reported by runs. Open group PRs: srs#1015 (relation-layer fixture, srs#180) and srs#1005 (core-bundle rename, srs#872) were both rejected by the reviewer only for a missing Mode/Cell/Door classification line in the PR body (the pr-classification check is red); #1005 is also behind master. Both wait on the builder to fix the body, #1005 for 4 days. srs-rust#1574, #1575, #1588 and #1598 are mergeable (clean, labelled gate:auto-merge) but have had no review since 5-9 Nov. Merged PRs without a quorum line: none. Owner-ruled escalations missing from either log: none found.

5. Budget: 3 of 10 delegated merges this cycle (counted by hand from the merged PRs; `group-state` read after the rollover shows 0); 6 open. Pause state: running.
5b. Awaiting ratification: none.

6. Next: the queue is not fed. Open issues labelled ready + wg:third-party-ready: srs-rust#1496 (blocked), #1495 (needs-input), #1164 (needs-input; core slices landed), #731 (blocked on #729 = PR #1598), #728 (landed in #1596, should close); srs#928 (blocked; RFC-054 landed, should close); srs-web#691 (needs-input, waits on bc6bc746). srs-vscode 0. Buildable now: 0. Top 3 in builder order (all P2, oldest first): srs-rust#728, #1164, #731, none actionable. Local priorities: none set. Queue running dry: 0 buildable ready, budget 10. Needs feeding: review the four mergeable srs-rust PRs, fix the two srs classification lines, close #728 and #928. Waits on the owner: the four decisions above. Fed by the analyst: nominated 3 (srs#1007 now landed via #1016, srs#180 in review as #1015, srs-rust#731 blocked) on 2026-11-08.

6b. Exercises: none open in the group log.

7. What we learned: two reviewer rejections (srs#1015, #1005) are the same cheap defect, a missing classification line, and have sat for days: the loop between a reject and the builder's fix has no owner. The gate boundary held again on srs#1016. Four escalations have waited 5 to 12 days, so the owner's queue, not the group's capacity, limits the work. Measurement I1: 0/0 (the window handed to `measure` opens at this close, so it says nothing); result 77f1d3bd-34f8-48ec-8831-b7caeb18d826; whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
fieldValues.rationale: No new escalation was raised: the four open escalations are unchanged and listed in section 1. No decision was ratified because no merged PR carried a decision assent line.
